question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"A person who enjoys the company of other ___."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Gregarious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"gregarious"** refers to someone who enjoys the company of others and tends to be sociable or outgoing. (सामाजिक)
 
 
• **Example: **Ravi is a gregarious person who loves attending parties and meeting new people.
 
 
• **Explanation: **The question asks for a one-word substitution for a person who enjoys the company of others. The correct word here is "gregarious," as it aptly describes such a personality. (सामाजिक)
 
 
• **Example: **A gregarious leader always inspires their team with positivity and enthusiasm.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Gregarious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Introvert** (अंतर्मुखी): A person who is shy, reserved, or prefers to spend time alone rather than in social settings.
 
 
• **Example:** As an introvert, she often spends her weekends reading books at home.
 
 
 
 
• **Egoist** (अहंकारी): A person who is self-centered and prioritizes their own interests over others.
 
 
• **Example:** His egoist behavior made it difficult for him to maintain friendships.
 
 

 
• **Pessimist** (निराशावादी): A person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen.
 
 
• **Example:** Being a pessimist, he always expects things to go wrong.
